title: Part Nine: The Money: IOR, APSA, Peter's Pence

sections.brief: The IOR from the 1887 Administration to Pius XII's chirograph of 27 June 1942; statutes of 2019 and 2023; who may hold accounts; Commission of Cardinals, Prelate, Board, Director General, auditor; 2024 and 2025 results (client assets vs own capital); dividend to the pope and what it funds; 2022 exclusivity rescript and Leo XIV's Coniuncta Cura (2025); labelled 'IOR = ROI' interpretation. Figures: fig-stats, fig-compare

APSA from the 1929 Special Administration to Regimini Ecclesiae Universae (15 August 1967); the Secretariat of State's assets transferred by motu proprio of 26 December 2020; APSA reports 2020-2025 (units, rents, contributions, 2025 balance sheet); Governorate and museums; Holy See consolidated statement 2024; pension fund. Figures: fig-money, fig-stats

Purpose of Peter's Pence per the Holy See (Guerrero 2021); London losses and the 2022 sale; reports for 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025: income, mission vs direct charity, donors; correction of the '10%' claim. Figures: fig-money, fig-stats

Canon 1256/1271/1273 ownership; what is on the published books and why the figures cannot be summed; heritage at symbolic value; tracing '$73bn' (Marketplace 2023) and '177 million acres' (no method); verdict on what can be said. Figures: fig-compare
